subject: Post-call: MAP - Integration workstream owners & target close
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Chris Taylor <ctaylor@medcore.io>, Elena Voss <elena@medcore.io>
Cc: ben_carter, dev_patel, marissa_cole
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: MAP - Integration workstream owners & target close

Hi Chris / Elena — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a first-pass MAP attachment so we can lock owners and a target close date. Attachment: RWI_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Top-level ask: please confirm the owner for each milestone below and any missing dependencies by EOD Monday so we can turn this into a shared project plan. Suggested target close: 2027-05-21 (end of next sprint cycle).

High-level milestones (draft):
- Milestone A — SDK integration (language bindings, config, auth): owner: dev_patel (Redwood) / MedCore tech owner: TBD
- Milestone B — Streaming + KV cache & live session tests: owner: marissa_cole (Redwood) / MedCore tech owner: TBD
- Milestone C — Tool-calling hooks & structured outputs (JSON schema): owner: dev_patel + marissa_cole (Redwood)
- Milestone D — Security/compliance signoffs (network, KMS, audit logs): owner: Priya Natarajan (sales/security liaison)
- Milestone E — Procurement & Contract execution (SOW, billing): owner: ben_carter (Redwood) / MedCore procurement: TBD

Dependencies noted on call: SOC 2 evidence exchange, VPC peering details, procurement PO timeline, and a short smoke-test environment from MedCore. If MedCore can confirm procurement lead and technical point-of-contact this week we should be able to hit the May 21 target.

Next steps I propose:
1) MedCore confirms internal owners for Tech & Procurement
2) Redwood (Dev + Eng) will produce an integration build plan (detailed tasks, owner by task) by next Wed 04/07
3) Quick sync (30m) week of 04/05 to align on acceptance criteria and test plan

Thanks — attaching the MAP draft and a one-page integration checklist.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RWI_MAP_v1.xlsx, rwi-integration-checklist.pdf

From: Chris Taylor <ctaylor@medcore.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Voss <elena@medcore.io>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP - Integration workstream owners & target close

Thanks Priya — appreciate the clear recap and the MAP draft. Quick responses from our side: Elena will be the technical owner for the integration workstream (Elena Voss). Procurement lead is Kevin Morales (kmorales@medcore.io) — he'll handle the PO and SOW.

A few notes / constraints from our infra team:
- We'll need to share the network diagram and allowable egress IPs for the VPC peering; attaching medcore-network-diagram.pdf.
- SOC 2 evidence request: we'll need the typical AICPA questionnaire plus the specifics around token retention and audit logs; can Priya/PT point to the doc we should fill out?
- We can commit to a technical sync 04/06 or 04/07 — prefer the 06th morning PST.

On timeline: May 21 sounds reasonable provided procurement closes by mid-April and we get the smoke-test env by 04/12.

Elena — looping you to confirm you'll be the point for technical signoff.

Thanks,
Chris
CTO, MedCore
ctaylor@medcore.io

Attachment: medcore-network-diagram.pdf

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Chris Taylor <ctaylor@medcore.io>, Elena Voss <elena@medcore.io>
Cc: ben_carter, dev_patel, marissa_cole
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP - Integration workstream owners & target close

Great — thanks Chris (and Elena). I've updated the MAP draft with the confirmed owners you gave and added suggested owners from our engineering side. See inline milestone owners below (this is the piece we'd like explicit confirmation for from Elena / Kevin):

Updated integration build plan (summary):
- SDK integration (auth, retries, language bindings, sample app) — Redwood owner: dev_patel; MedCore owner: Elena Voss; target: 2027-04-28; deliverable: SDK sample app + integration guide (v0.1)
- Streaming & session correctness (low-latency streaming, KV cache behavior, session replay) — Redwood owner: marissa_cole; MedCore owner: Elena Voss; target: 2027-05-07; deliverable: smoke-test report + perf baseline
- Tool calling & structured outputs (tool schema, output validation, function wiring) — Redwood owners: dev_patel + marissa_cole; MedCore owner: Elena Voss; target: 2027-05-14; deliverable: validated JSON schemas + sample tool call traces
- Security & infra signoff (VPC peering, KMS, audit logs, data residency) — Redwood owner: priya_natarajan; MedCore owner: Kevin Morales; target: 2027-05-18; deliverable: signed infra checklist + SOC2 evidence pointer
- Procurement / Contract execution — Redwood owner: ben_carter; MedCore owner: Kevin Morales; target: 2027-04-15; deliverable: signed SOW + initial invoice schedule

Action items for this thread (please reply inline):
- Elena: confirm MedCore tech owner and that targets above are achievable (particularly 04/28 for SDK sample)
- Kevin (procurement): confirm PO timeline and whether we should route SOW via DocuSign or your procurement portal
- Redwood Eng (dev_patel / marissa_cole): I'll need a short bulleted build plan (task-level) by 04/07 so we can map to sprints — see the attached integration checklist for the template.

I'll schedule the 30m sync for 04/06 09:00 PST per Chris's suggestion; calendar invite attached.

—Priya

Attachments: RWI_MAP_v1.xlsx, rwi-integration-checklist.pdf

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Chris Taylor <ctaylor@medcore.io>, Elena Voss <elena@medcore.io>
Cc: ben_carter, marissa_cole
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: MAP - Integration workstream owners & target close

Quick note from eng: we reviewed the targets and they look doable with the assumptions below. I'll produce the task-level build plan by EOD 04/07 as requested.

Assumptions / asks for MedCore to unblock dev work:
- Provide an account-level API key and a small test dataset OR a staging endpoint we can use for end-to-end validation (token-limited)
- Confirm whether you require TLS client certs for streaming or if standard mTLS via our LB is OK
- Share the SOC2 evidence request doc (Priya — can you attach the standard questionnaire we want MedCore to complete?)

Planned deliverables in the build plan (short):
1) SDK task list: authentication layer + example in Node + Python + config toggles for streaming
2) Streaming: continuous batching flags, ability to disable prefix caching for tests, perf harness setup
3) Tool-calling: example JSON schema, dry-run harness, validator tests
4) Acceptance criteria: smoke test scripts + pass/fail thresholds for latency and correctness

If MedCore can confirm the staging account by 04/12 we'll be able to produce the smoke-test report by 05/07.

—Dev
Senior Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
raw_thread_text_searchable: Priya Natarajan sent a MAP draft. Chris/Elena confirmed owners. Dev to produce build plan by 04/07. Procurement owner Kevin Morales (MedCore). Attachments include MAP and network diagram. Target close 2027-05-21.
